headline: Most failed attempts pass when the test is retried.

rootCause.statement: The payment button is not consistently ready when the test clicks it.

reasoning.step: The execution history alternates between pass and fail.
Retry recovery is observed in most failed runs.

confidenceRationale: Two independent signals agree on intermittent timing.

recommendedAction.action: Replace the fixed wait with an assertion-based wait on the confirm button.
recommendedAction.ticketDraft: Stabilize the declined-card checkout test by waiting for the confirm button to be enabled.
